title: Repair and Rehabilitation
intro: Delivering comprehensive repair and rehabilitation solutions, our products are designed to restore, strengthen, and enhance the performance of damaged or deteriorated structures. They address cracks, surface wear, and structural weaknesses, ensuring long-lasting durability, improved safety, and extended service life for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.

products.name: Cemrepair PMC
products.description: Bronco® CEMREPAIR PMC is a high-performance, polymer-modified cementitious repair mortar designed for structural and non-structural concrete repairs. It provides excellent adhesion, high compressive strength, and shrinkage control for durable restoration. Supplied in 25 kg bags with a 12-month shelf life.

products.name: Cemrepair MC
products.description: Bronco® CEMREPAIR MC is a single-component, fiber-reinforced, polymer-modified repair mortar for medium to heavy concrete restoration. It offers excellent bonding, high strength, and low shrinkage, ensuring long-lasting structural durability. Supplied in 25 kg bags with a 12-month shelf life.

products.name: Cemrepair Rapid
products.description: Cemrepair Rapid is a repair and rehabilitation solution from Ethios that restores, strengthens, and extends the life of damaged structures. Contact our technical team for the data sheet and application guidance.

products.name: Cempu Grout
products.description: Bronco® CEMPU GROUT is a ready-to-use, non-shrink, high-performance cementitious grout designed for precision grouting in foundations, machinery base plates, columns, and anchor bolts. It provides excellent flowability, high early and final compressive strength, and controlled expansion for void-free placement. Supplied in 25 kg moisture-resistant bags, with a shelf life of 12 months.

products.name: Cemcon XL5451
products.description: Bronco® CEMCON XL5451 is a ready-to-use, non-shrink, high-strength cementitious grout formulated for precision grouting of heavy machinery foundations, columns, base plates, and anchorages. It ensures high early and final compressive strength, excellent flow characteristics, and controlled expansion for complete void filling. Supplied in 25 kg moisture-resistant bags with a shelf life of 12 months.

products.name: Crack Seal
products.description: Bronco® CRACK SEAL is a ready-to-use, polymer-based crack filler designed for repairing surface cracks in plaster, concrete, and masonry. It offers excellent adhesion, flexibility, and weather resistance, ensuring long-lasting crack sealing without shrinkage. Ideal for both interior and exterior applications. Supplied in convenient packaging with a shelf life of 12 months.

products.name: Bronco Rustkil
products.description: BRONCO® RUSTKIL is a single-component, ready-to-use rust remover and passivator specially formulated to treat corroded steel surfaces before repair or coating. It effectively removes rust, forms a stable protective layer, and improves the bond between steel and subsequent coatings or repair materials. Ideal for use in concrete rehabilitation and maintenance works. Supplied in sealed containers with a shelf life of 12 months.

products.name: Bronco ZRP
products.description: BRONCO® ZRP is a single-component, zinc-rich primer formulated to provide excellent corrosion protection for steel reinforcement and metal surfaces. It forms a strong, durable barrier that prevents rust formation and enhances the bond between steel and repair mortars. Ideal for use in concrete repair systems and protective coatings. Supplied in sealed containers with a shelf life of 12 months.

products.name: Chryso DP Bonding Agent
products.description: CHRYSO® DP Bonding Agent is a two-component, solvent-free thixotropic epoxy system designed for structural bonding of old-to-new or old-to-old concrete. It offers excellent adhesion, even on vertical and overhead surfaces, and cures in dry or damp conditions. Ideal for construction joints, repairs, and civil infrastructure applications, conforming to ASTM C 881 standards.

products.name: Chryso Rustkill
products.description: CHRYSO® RUSTKILL is a powerful, ready-to-use rust and stain remover formulated for iron, steel, marble, tiles, and household metal surfaces. It promotes paint adhesion by eliminating corrosion and stains quickly and effectively. Non-flammable, biodegradable, and chloride-free, it ensures safe use in both industrial and domestic applications.

products.name: Chryso Excem MC 40
products.description: CHRYSO® EXCEM MC 40 is a single-component, polymer-modified micro concrete designed for structural repair and restoration in hard-to-reach areas. With excellent flowability, controlled expansion, and compressive strength up to 40 MPa, it’s ideal for columns, beams, and foundation repairs. Easy to apply by pour, pump, or trowel with high durability and bond strength.

products.name: Chryso Excem PMC 40
products.description: CHRYSO® EXCEM PMC 40 is a polymer-modified, fibre-reinforced non-structural repair mortar designed for vertical and overhead concrete applications. It offers excellent resistance to corrosion, carbonation, and shrinkage cracking, with a compressive strength of over 40 MPa. Ideal for reinstating deteriorated concrete with superior bonding and durability.

products.name: Chryso Struco Latex
products.description: CHRYSO® STRUCO LATEX is a single-component, SBR-based waterproofing and bonding compound that enhances adhesion, flexibility, and water resistance in cementitious mixes. Ideal for plastering, damp-proofing, grouting, and repair applications, it effectively prevents efflorescence, saltpetre, and fungal growth. Suitable for walls, basements, roofs, and marine structures.

products.name: Chryso Excem MC 60
products.description: CHRYSO® EXCEM MC 60 is a single-component, high-strength, flowable micro concrete ideal for structural repairs in restricted access areas. With compressive strength exceeding 60 MPa, controlled expansion, and excellent workability, it ensures durable restoration of beams, columns, tunnels, and industrial floors. Chloride-free and pumpable, it offers superior bonding and shrinkage control.

products.name: Chryso Excem PMC 50
products.description: CHRYSO® EXCEM PMC 50 is a high-performance, polymer-modified, fibre reinforced repair mortar ideal for structural rehabilitation of vertical and overhead concrete surfaces. With excellent thixotropy, crack resistance, and a compressive strength of over 50 MPa, it provides long-lasting protection against corrosion, carbonation, and environmental exposure.

products.name: Chryso Excem PMC 60
products.description: CHRYSO® EXCEM PMC 60 is a high-strength, polymer-modified, fibre-reinforced repair mortar ideal for structural concrete restoration in vertical and overhead areas. With compressive strength >60 MPa, it offers excellent corrosion and carbonation resistance, controlled expansion, and superior bond to concrete and steel. Easy to apply by trowel or spray with long-term durability.

products.name: Chryso Polycaulk PS
products.description: CHRYSO® POLYCAULK PS is a two-part, fuel-resistant polysulphide joint sealant designed for expansion joints in concrete pavements, runways, parking lots, and dynamic cracks. It forms a tough, elastic, and UV-stable seal with excellent chemical resistance and adhesion to concrete, stone, brick, metal, and wood. Available in gun grade and pour grade for vertical and horizontal applications.

products.name: SikaEmaco-SBR 2
products.description: SikaEmaco® SBR 2 is a high-dispersion SBR latex used as a bonding agent and waterproofing additive for cement-based mortars, screeds, and repair works. It enhances adhesion, flexibility, and crack resistance while improving waterproofing and abrasion durability. Ideal for concrete repair, plaster bonding, and protective coatings in bathrooms, basements, and terraces.

products.name: Sika MonoTop-122 F
products.description: Sika MonoTop®-122 F is a dual shrinkage-compensated, fibre-reinforced, thixotropic repair mortar ideal for vertical and overhead structural concrete repairs. It offers high compressive strength (up to 50 MPa), superior adhesion, and ease of application with trowel or spray. Suitable for use in buildings, bridges, and infrastructure restoration.

products.name: SikaRep Microcrete-4
products.description: SikaRep® Microcrete-4 is a high-performance, non-shrink, pourable microconcrete designed for deep section repairs and structural jacketing. With excellent flowability, rapid strength gain (up to 65 MPa in 28 days), and no vibration required, it’s ideal for bridges, columns, tunnels, culverts, and marine structures. Conforms to ASTM and tested by IITs for trusted durability.

products.name: Sika Polysulphide Pour Grade
products.description: Sika® Polysulphide Pour Grade is a two-component, pourable sealant ideal for horizontal expansion joints in concrete, precast elements, highways, bridges, and water-retaining structures. It offers permanent flexibility, excellent adhesion, and high resistance to water, fuels, oils, and weathering. Conforms to BS, IS, and IRC standards for industrial-grade joint sealing.

products.name: MasterEmaco SBR 3
products.description: MasterEmaco® SBR 3 is a high-quality Styrene-Butadiene (SBR) latex modifier used in waterproofing, concrete repair, and bonding applications. It enhances adhesion, reduces shrinkage and cracking, and improves flexibility and abrasion resistance of cementitious mortars and screeds. Ideal for basements, bathrooms, water tanks, and structural repairs.

products.name: Sika Polysulphide Gun Grade
products.description: Sika® Polysulphide Gun Grade is a two-component, non-sag, elastomeric sealant designed for vertical and overhead expansion joints in concrete and precast structures. It offers excellent adhesion, high flexibility (±25% movement), and superior resistance to UV, fuel, oils, and weathering. Ideal for bridges, tunnels, water tanks, airports, and façade joints.

products.name: SikaLatex Super
products.description: SikaLatex® Super is a high-performance SBR-based multipurpose polymer designed for waterproofing, bonding, and repair applications. It enhances adhesion, flexibility, and abrasion resistance in cement-based mortars, screeds, and coatings. Ideal for waterproof plastering, tile fixing, and concrete repairs in rooftops, basements, bathrooms, and water tanks.

products.name: SikaCem 130 Intraplast
products.description: SikaCem®-130 Intraplast® is a chloride-free, non-shrink, expanding grout admixture in powder form, ideal for cementitious injection grouting. It enhances fluidity, cohesion, and bond strength while preventing segregation and bleeding. Perfect for anchor grouting, cable ducts, rock/soil anchoring, and tunnel linings, especially in hot and tropical conditions.

products.name: SikaEmaco S 348
products.description: SikaEmaco® S 348 is a high-strength, fibre-reinforced, thixotropic repair mortar ideal for structural concrete repairs on vertical and overhead surfaces. Dual shrinkage compensated and sprayable, it provides excellent adhesion, crack resistance, and durability. Perfect for restoring beams, columns, bridges, marine structures, and industrial assets.

products.name: Technonicol SBR Latex
products.description: TECHNONICOL® SBR Latex is a high-performance styrene-butadiene emulsion designed for waterproofing, repair, and concrete bonding applications. It enhances mortar strength, adhesion, flexibility, and resistance to chloride, CO₂, and cracking. Ideal for use in plastering, damp-proofing, grouting, DPC, and tile bedding across roofs, basements, water tanks, and RCC structures.

products.name: Dr. Fixit Polymer Mortar HB
products.description: Dr. Fixit Polymer Mortar HB is a high-performance, fibre-reinforced structural repair mortar designed for vertical and overhead concrete restoration. It offers dual shrinkage compensation, excellent adhesion to steel and concrete, and meets EN 1504-3 Class R4 standards. Ideal for repairing slabs, beams, columns, facades, bridges, and industrial infrastructure.

products.name: Dr. Fixit Super Latex
products.description: Dr. Fixit Super Latex is a 100% acrylic bonding agent ideal for waterproofing, repair, and concrete bonding applications. It improves adhesion, flexibility, and resistance to shrinkage, cracking, and abrasion in cementitious mixes. Suitable for repairing spalled concrete, bonding old-to-new concrete, floor screeds, and protective coatings in wet areas like bathrooms and terraces.

products.name: Nitobond SBR Latex
products.description: Fosroc Nitobond® SBR is a styrene-butadiene rubber-based bonding agent and waterproofing admixture that enhances adhesion, flexibility, and durability in cementitious mortars. Ideal for floor screeds, waterproof renders, tile mortars, and concrete repairs, it improves workability, crack resistance, and performance in both vertical and overhead applications. Suitable for internal and external use.

products.name: Tremco Vandex BB 75
products.description: TREMCO VANDEX® BB 75 by Tremco CPG is a ready-to-use, cementitious waterproofing slurry ideal for concrete and masonry. It provides robust protection against both active and passive water pressure, making it suitable for foundations, retaining walls, slabs, and drinking water tanks. Sprayable and efflorescence-free, it ensures long-lasting waterproofing performance with excellent adhesion.

products.name: Weber SBR Litx
products.description: Weber SBR LitX is a high-performance styrene-butadiene rubber latex used as a bonding agent and waterproofing admixture for cement-based applications. It improves workability, adhesion, and resistance to water, chemicals, and abrasion. Ideal for repairs, plastering, screeding, and waterproofing of basements, terraces, and water-retaining structures.

products.name: Webertec NSG-2
products.description: Webertec NSG 2 is a high-performance, non-shrink cementitious grout suitable for anchoring, precision grouting, and non-structural concrete repairs. With triple consistency (fluid, pourable, trowelable), it delivers high early and ultimate compressive strength with zero bleeding or segregation. Ideal for base plates, anchor bolts, pile caps, and tie rods.
